name: Scout (Competitive Intelligence)
description: Tracks what competitors change on their sites, how search rankings shift, and whether your pages surface in AI-generated answers, then flags the changes that actually matter. Aimed at organic growth work, so paid channels and product-level competitive analysis fall outside what it covers.

official.title: Scout by Adam
official.description: A competitive intelligence agent for organic growth that watches rival sites, search rankings, and AI-answer visibility so real moves don’t get buried...
